attacks.claim: The plan treats the Vector redaction stage as sufficient for sending logs to an external LLM, but that stage only masks a short list of identifier types. Other personal data in free-text log lines (names, phone numbers, addresses, customer or account identifiers) would reach the third-party model with no stated check.
attacks.evidence: "which already masks emails, tokens, card numbers and IPs for our log retention policy (audited in Q1)" — ABSENT: an audit or sampling of post-redaction log content for personal data outside those four categories, and no mention of a data-minimisation step before the LLM call.
